query: Explain why the loop replanned slice 3 after the fix attempts on its second task ran out.
expected_output: Distinguishes the inner fix loop (same task, retried with findings, bounded attempts) from the outer replan loop (whole remaining plan, bounded by the replan budget); explains the replan starts from the current state, leaves finished work untouched, feeds the failure's cause in, and returns revised tasks in the same shape or a reasoned stop.

expectations.text: Distinguishes the fix loop (retries the same task) from the replan loop (changes the remaining plan)
States that a replan starts from the current state and never reissues finished work
States that the failure's cause is fed into the replan so the next path is different
States the replanner either returns revised tasks in the original shape or stops and says why

query: Launch the loop on the EXPORT project in preview.
expected_output: Launching the loop is `orchestrate`'s job; adaptive-replanning only explains, tunes or debugs replanning.

expectations.text: Does not launch the workflow itself
Does not pass `execute: true` or start any agent dispatch

query: We set maxReplans to 0. Slice 2 failed its review after the fix rounds, and the whole run stopped. Why, and what happened to slices 3 to 5?
expected_output: Explains that a replan budget of zero turns replanning off, so the first failed slice stops the run; the untried tasks are marked skipped so nothing is silently dropped, and the run report lists them.

expectations.text: States that a replan budget of zero disables replanning so the first failed slice stops the run
States that the untried tasks (slices 3 to 5) are marked as skipped, not silently dropped
Does not claim the loop would retry or replan slice 2

query: The loop has stopped three runs in a row on the same cause: nobody has decided whether exports include archived records. Should I raise maxReplans to 10?
expected_output: Advises against raising the budget: the same stop cause recurring signals an open design question; take it back to the design stage (roast), settle it, and rerun. Replanning routes around execution dead ends but does not invent product decisions.

expectations.text: Does not recommend raising the replan budget as the fix
Identifies the recurring stop cause as an open design question
Recommends taking it back to the design stage (`roast`), settling it, and rerunning
